name: E07_5_firespitter_whelp_the_damage_is_still_dealt_when_the_whelp_has_left
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.' Seat 0 casts Opt (an instant) and holds priority: the Whelp's trigger waits on the stack. The Whelp is put into the graveyard in response. The ability is independent of its source (CR 113.7a) and the Whelp deals the damage as it last existed (CR 608.2h): seat 1 still takes 1 (19). Seat 0 takes none.
